title: Cilia
level: Researchers (as stated on the event page)
about: EMBO Workshop "Cilia" will take place in Stresa, Italy, from 9 to 12 March 2027. Registration closes on 1 January 2027. A late registration deadline of 22 February 2027 is also listed. Applications are made through the event page on the EMBO meetings website.
